questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that a yield sign is coming up ahead. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There are trucks hauling gravel ahead.
The highway ahead is under construction.
The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
The highway ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you the road ahead has loose gravel. Drive carefully because loose gravel reduces tire traction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An intersection is coming up. Watch for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way lanes with a divider between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a playground is near. Watch for children in or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
questions.explanation: A curve is coming in the direction shown by the arrow. The sign recommends driving at 35 mph or slower through the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you that an intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic light to tell left-turning drivers they do not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: The road ahead will make a sharp turn to the right and then a sharp turn to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing ahead. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or catch on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a pedestrian crossing area. Watch for people in the crosswalk. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns drivers about work zones where traffic violations are punished with increased fines. Drive carefully to protect yourself and construction workers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black markings. This sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive with caution because bicycles regularly cross or ride in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you not to enter. The road is one-way, and you are approaching from the wrong direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Be prepared to allow merging vehicles to enter safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a detour is 1,000 feet ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that the shoulder ahead is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down when approaching railroad tracks. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for trains to pass before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns you that wet pavement is slippery and your vehicle may be harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that traffic is moving in both directions on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must come to a complete stop and look for pedestrians and crossing traffic. Only proceed when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are present on or near the road. Slow down and use extra caution in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an intersection ahead where a road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs display rules that drivers must follow. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that an additional lane is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.
